UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$base='{{$FullBaseDir}}'; $nested=Join-Path $base 'server_distribution'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $nested) { Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $nested '*') -Destination $base -Recurse -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $nested -Recurse -Force }; $assets=Join-Path $base 'assets'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $assets | Out-Null; $exe=Join-Path $base 'win\starbound_server.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) { throw ('OpenStarbound Windows layout normalization did not produce expected server executable: ' + $exe) }"
-c "cd openstarbound/server && rm -f win >/dev/null 2>&1; ln -sf linux win >/dev/null 2>&1"
